fix: Every paint of a shimmer child allocates a 5-entry Vec for GradientStops::new (gradients.rs:101 takes Vec and sorts it in place). Remove the per-paint Vec: change GradientStops storage to SmallVec<[GradientStop; 8]> (smallvec is already shared in the workspace) and make `new` take `impl IntoIterator<Item = GradientStop>`, then pass the array directly here: `GradientStops::new([GradientStop { offset: 0., color: incular_core::Color::WHITE }, ...])`. Keep the stable sort/clamp behaviour unchanged.

bind() allocates a new Rc<dyn Fn()> wake closure (and a new subscriptions Vec, re-subscribing every source) on every call. Paint-tier effects make the node rebuild each frame, so bind can run per frame. Create the wake Rc once in Timeline::new (store `wake: Rc<dyn Fn()>` capturing a clone of live_dirty) and use `self.wake.clone()` in bind. Also skip the `written_props` recomputation when `Rc::ptr_eq` shows the spec is unchanged, and only re-subscribe when the Cond or Progress source actually changed.
Read the progress once: `let next = head.progress(); let moved = self.position.replace(next) != next;`
